about.title: My journey
about.p1: My adventure in photography began in 2014, driven by a passion to capture the beauty of the world around me.
about.p2: A turning point came in 2016 when one of my photographs was published in an international magazine — it opened new horizons and inspired me deeply.
about.p3: That same year I enrolled at Yarmouk University to study Computer Engineering and graduated in 2022.
about.p4: In 2018 I started working at a small studio to learn and grow. That experience opened my eyes to the magic of videography and cemented my love for cinema.
about.p5: I keep learning and evolving with every new opportunity, grateful for every moment that brought me here.
about.cv_sub: Download my CV for a full overview of my background, projects, and the skills I've built along the way.
